family: D — flow / liquidity (low-correlation with A and B)
structure: Pure flow/liquidity factor with NO price reversal/direction. Blends 4 sign-corrected signals: Amihud illiquidity (|ret|/(close*volume)), net share issuance (delta sharesout), share turnover (volume/sharesout), abnormal volume (z-score of volume). Economically orthogonal to the reversal-driven Families A and B.
note: max|corr| = 0.375 < 0.50 target. Near-zero correlation with Family A. The 0.375 with Family B reflects shared Amihud/issuance/turnover components; the volume-z-score component is unique to this factor.
